summary.en: Blur vs Oasis sold papers. The music was already different; the feud was the product.
summary.zh: Blur vs Oasis 卖报纸。音乐本来就不一样；撕逼才是产品。

body.en:
NME and tabloids need a title fight. Two bands from the same decade get cast as enemies even when the catalogs barely overlap.

Sometimes the artists lean into it for charts. Sometimes they hate the script and still get quoted into it. Read the records first; treat the "war" as marketing with better lighting.
body.zh:
NME 和小报需要一场拳赛。同年代两支乐队被写成死敌——哪怕碟谱几乎不重叠。

有时艺人自己靠这个冲榜。有时他们讨厌剧本，仍被引用进局里。先听碟；把「战争」当打光更好的营销。

note.zh: Liam/Noel 金句当每周内容更新。

note.en: Parklife pole vs Knebworth pole—same chart war, different tools.
note.zh: Parklife 极 vs Knebworth 极——同一场榜单战，工具不同。
